answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 7066 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: What is the meaning of these two names: Muhammad Ayyan and Abeeha. Can one name their children with these? Question: Assalamualaykum warahmatullahi wabarakatuhu; Respected Ulama e deen, What is the meaning of these two names: Muhammad Ayyan and Abeeha. Can one name their children with these? Wassalam Answer ID: 7066 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 705/705=M/1429) Ayyan ( عیان ) means: the most seen, if it is Ayan then it means: person, self, sharp point of plough. We could not find the meaning of Abeeha. The abovementioned names are not suitable ones, you should choose some other good names. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
